items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: this Club in Stuenville, Ohio where I worked with Harry

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

That was about it. I didn't have alot of those earlier experiences. Once I got that opportunity to sing alone with Harry, and I was quite sheltered, you know. In fact this Club, this Club in Stuenville, Ohio where I worked with Harry, they served three-point-two beers, you know. I think they probably served a little bit of wine. But anyway, I could have the three-and-two-tenths percent beer, but the management told the boys that if he caught any of them giving me anything stronger that they would be fired. So…

Now I wasn't a baby, you know, but I think because I was small everybody must have considered I was much younger than I was. But I certainly wasn't a minor. I was old enough. They just didn't want to believe it.
